item.title: TraceGrade: Evaluating LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Tool-Use Tasks with Step-Level Verification
item.description: arXiv:2609.99001v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Benchmarks for LLM agents usually score only the final answer of a multi-step episode. We introduce TraceGrade, a benchmark of 1,240 multi-step tool-use tasks across web, shell, and spreadsheet environments in which every intermediate action is verified against an executable checker. Evaluating 14 LLM agents, we find that final-answer accuracy overstates step-level correctness by up to 31 points. Code and tasks are publicly released.
item.dc:creator: Mira Okafor, Tomás Lindqvist, Hae-won Seo, Priya Raman

item.title: Calibrated Abstention for Language Model Question Answering via Conformal Uncertainty
item.description: arXiv:2609.99002v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Language model predictions are often overconfident, which makes abstention unreliable. We propose a conformal procedure that turns token-level signals into calibrated uncertainty estimation for open-domain question answering. Across five datasets, our method reduces expected calibration error by 43% and lets the language model abstain with a guaranteed error rate.
item.dc:creator: Jonas Brandt, Aiko Tanaka, Lucía Ferrer

item.title: Rerank Less, Retrieve Better: Query-Adaptive Depth for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
item.description: arXiv:2609.99003v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation pipelines typically rerank a fixed number of passages. We show that retrieval quality for question answering depends strongly on query difficulty, and train a lightweight controller that chooses retrieval depth per query. The controller cuts reranker calls by 58% while improving answer accuracy on four question answering benchmarks.
item.dc:creator: Samir Haddad, Elena Petrova

item.title: SpecTree: Draft Trees for Faster Speculative Decoding in Large Language Models
item.description: arXiv:2609.99004v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by verifying draft tokens in parallel. We propose SpecTree, which drafts a tree of continuations and prunes it with a learned acceptance model. SpecTree delivers 3.1x faster decoding than autoregressive sampling with identical outputs, and composes with quantization for cheaper inference. Code is available.
item.dc:creator: Wei Zhang, Olivia Grant, Rafael Moreno, Chen Li

item.title: A Survey of Uncertainty Estimation in Large Language Models
item.description: arXiv:2609.99005v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We review methods for uncertainty estimation in large language models, covering verbalized confidence, sampling consistency, and probe-based approaches. We organize the literature by the kind of prediction being scored and discuss open problems in calibration for long-form generation.
item.dc:creator: Grace Mensah, Daniel Kowalski

item.title: Low-Dose CT Denoising with Diffusion Priors and Calibrated Uncertainty Maps
item.description: arXiv:2609.99006v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a diffusion-based denoiser for low-dose CT scans in medical imaging that also outputs calibrated uncertainty maps. On two public CT datasets the method improves structural similarity while highlighting regions where radiologists should double-check the reconstruction.
item.dc:creator: Hannah Weiss, Kofi Asante, Marta Silva

item.title: Equivariant Graph Networks for Crystal Property Prediction
item.description: arXiv:2609.99007v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We design an equivariant graph neural network for predicting formation energy and band gap of inorganic crystals. The model sets a new state of the art on two materials benchmarks while using 40% fewer parameters.
item.dc:creator: Ivan Sokolov, Mei Lin

item.title: On the Sample Complexity of Offline Reinforcement Learning with Linear Function Approximation
item.description: arXiv:2609.99008v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We establish minimax lower bounds on the sample complexity of offline reinforcement learning under linear function approximation and give an algorithm whose upper bound matches them up to logarithmic factors.
item.dc:creator: Noah Fischer, Amara Nwosu

item.title: Do LLM Agents Know When They Are Wrong? Self-Evaluation of Tool-Use Trajectories
item.description: arXiv:2609.99009v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study whether LLM agents can evaluate their own multi-step tool-use trajectories. Agents' self-reported confidence is poorly calibrated: across three agent benchmarks, trajectories rated 90% likely to succeed succeed only 61% of the time. A simple uncertainty estimation probe on hidden states recovers much of the gap.
item.dc:creator: Laura Chen, Pedro Alves, Yuki Mori

item.title: 4-Bit KV Cache Compression for Long-Context LLM Inference
item.description: arXiv:2609.99010v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-context LLM inference is dominated by KV cache memory. We introduce a 4-bit quantization scheme for the KV cache with per-channel outlier handling that keeps perplexity within 0.1 of full precision and enables 2.6x cheaper inference at 128k context.
item.dc:creator: Arjun Mehta, Sofia Rossi

item.title: Tabular Foundation Models for Clinical Risk Prediction
item.description: arXiv:2609.99011v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We evaluate tabular foundation models on 22 clinical risk prediction tasks from electronic health records and find that they match gradient-boosted trees with far less tuning.
item.dc:creator: Emily Carter, Ravi Iyer, Beatriz Santos

item.title: Visual Place Recognition under Seasonal Change
item.description: arXiv:2609.99012v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We address visual place recognition across seasons with a contrastive objective on paired summer and winter images, improving recall at 1 by nine points on three outdoor datasets.
item.dc:creator: Anders Holm, Keiko Sato

item.title: SciRetrieve: A Benchmark of Retrieval Quality for Scientific Question Answering
item.description: arXiv:2609.99013v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We release SciRetrieve, a benchmark of 9,800 expert-written scientific questions with passage-level relevance labels, to measure retrieval quality for retrieval-augmented question answering. Dense retrievers and rerankers still miss a supporting passage for 27% of questions.
item.dc:creator: Oluwaseun Adeyemi, Clara Dubois

item.title: Position: Evaluating Autonomous Agents Needs Cost-Aware Metrics
item.description: arXiv:2609.99014v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We argue that evaluating LLM agents by success rate alone hides the cost of multi-step tool-use. We propose reporting success per dollar and per minute and show how rankings on popular agent benchmarks change under cost-aware metrics.
item.dc:creator: Michael Brooks, Anika Sharma

item.title: Emergent Communication in Multi-Robot Foraging
item.description: arXiv:2609.99015v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We train teams of simulated robots to forage and observe the emergence of a compositional signalling protocol that transfers to new arena layouts.
item.dc:creator: Lucas Martin, Zainab Hussain

item.title: Prompt Compression for Long Documents with Learned Token Dropping
item.description: arXiv:2609.99016v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We learn which prompt tokens can be dropped before a language model reads a long document, reducing prompt length by 60% with a small drop in summarization quality.
item.dc:creator: A. Researcher, B. Scientist

item.title: A Dataset of Tool Descriptions for API Retrieval
item.description: arXiv:2609.99017v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We collect 48,000 API tool descriptions and user requests and study retrieval of the right tool for a request, reporting dense and sparse retrieval baselines.
item.dc:creator: A. Researcher, B. Scientist

item.title: Self-Supervised Pretraining for Seismic Event Detection
item.description: arXiv:2609.99018v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We pretrain a transformer on unlabeled seismograms and fine-tune it to detect small earthquakes, doubling recall for low-magnitude events.
item.dc:creator: A. Researcher, B. Scientist

item.title: Topological Phases in Twisted Bilayer Graphene at Fractional Filling
item.description: arXiv:2609.99019v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We compute the phase diagram of twisted bilayer graphene at fractional filling and identify a region with a fractional Chern insulator ground state.
item.dc:creator: A. Researcher, B. Scientist

item.title: Fair Division of Indivisible Goods with Budget Constraints
item.description: arXiv:2609.99020v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study envy-free allocations of indivisible goods when agents face budget constraints and give a polynomial-time algorithm for two agents.
item.dc:creator: A. Researcher, B. Scientist

item.title: Neural Radiance Fields for Dynamic Urban Scenes
item.description: arXiv:2609.99021v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We extend neural radiance fields to large dynamic street scenes by decomposing static background and moving vehicles, improving novel-view synthesis quality.
item.dc:creator: A. Researcher, B. Scientist

item.title: Bayesian Optimization of Battery Electrolyte Formulations
item.description: arXiv:2609.99022v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We run closed-loop Bayesian optimization over electrolyte recipes and find a formulation with 18% higher ionic conductivity in 40 experiments.
item.dc:creator: A. Researcher, B. Scientist

item.title: Lower Bounds for Streaming Graph Connectivity
item.description: arXiv:2609.99023v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We prove space lower bounds for deciding connectivity in dynamic graph streams under a bounded number of passes.
item.dc:creator: A. Researcher, B. Scientist

item.title: Diffusion Models for Protein Backbone Generation with Symmetry Constraints
item.description: arXiv:2609.99024v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We condition a diffusion model on point-group symmetry to generate protein backbones for symmetric assemblies, improving designability in silico.
item.dc:creator: A. Researcher, B. Scientist

item.title: Measuring the Hubble Constant with Strongly Lensed Supernovae
item.description: arXiv:2609.99025v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We forecast the precision of Hubble constant measurements from time delays of lensed supernovae expected in the next survey decade.
item.dc:creator: A. Researcher, B. Scientist

item.title: Robust Legged Locomotion on Deformable Terrain
item.description: arXiv:2609.99026v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We train a quadruped controller in simulation with randomized soil models and deploy it on sand and snow without fine-tuning.
item.dc:creator: A. Researcher, B. Scientist

item.title: Federated Learning with Heterogeneous Label Distributions
item.description: arXiv:2609.99027v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We analyze federated averaging when clients see disjoint label sets and propose a server-side correction that improves accuracy under skew.
item.dc:creator: A. Researcher, B. Scientist

item.title: An Empirical Study of Code Review Comments in Open Source
item.description: arXiv:2609.99028v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We label 12,000 code review comments from open-source projects and find that a third concern naming and readability rather than defects.
item.dc:creator: A. Researcher, B. Scientist

item.title: Quantum Error Mitigation with Probabilistic Error Cancellation at Scale
item.description: arXiv:2609.99029v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We implement probabilistic error cancellation on a 27-qubit device and characterize its sampling overhead for circuits of increasing depth.
item.dc:creator: A. Researcher, B. Scientist

item.title: Causal Discovery from Time Series with Latent Confounders
item.description: arXiv:2609.99030v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We give an identifiability result and an algorithm for causal discovery in multivariate time series when some confounders are unobserved.
item.dc:creator: A. Researcher, B. Scientist

item.title: Cross-Lingual Transfer for Hate Speech Detection in Low-Resource Languages
item.description: arXiv:2609.99031v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We compare translation-based and multilingual encoder approaches to hate speech detection in six low-resource languages.
item.dc:creator: A. Researcher, B. Scientist

item.title: Energy-Efficient Scheduling for Edge Inference Clusters
item.description: arXiv:2609.99032v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We schedule vision model inference jobs across heterogeneous edge devices to minimize energy under latency constraints.
item.dc:creator: A. Researcher, B. Scientist

item.title: A Large-Scale Study of Citation Practices in Machine Learning
item.description: arXiv:2609.99033v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We analyze 400,000 machine learning papers and find a growing share of citations to preprints that are never formally published.
item.dc:creator: A. Researcher, B. Scientist

item.title: Optimal Transport for Single-Cell Trajectory Inference
item.description: arXiv:2609.99034v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We use unbalanced optimal transport to infer developmental trajectories from single-cell RNA snapshots, recovering known lineages in three datasets.
item.dc:creator: A. Researcher, B. Scientist

item.title: Solving Olympiad Geometry with Symbolic Search
item.description: arXiv:2609.99035v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We combine a symbolic deduction engine with a learned construction proposer and solve 27 of 30 olympiad geometry problems.
item.dc:creator: A. Researcher, B. Scientist

item.title: Adversarial Patches Against Traffic Sign Detectors in the Physical World
item.description: arXiv:2609.99036v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We print adversarial patches that cause traffic sign detectors to miss stop signs in 71% of real-world drive-by tests.
item.dc:creator: A. Researcher, B. Scientist

item.title: Monotone Operator Splitting for Constrained Convex Optimization
item.description: arXiv:2609.99037v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a three-operator splitting scheme with adaptive step sizes and prove linear convergence under metric subregularity.
item.dc:creator: A. Researcher, B. Scientist

item.title: Speech Emotion Recognition with Self-Supervised Features
item.description: arXiv:2609.99038v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We benchmark self-supervised speech representations for emotion recognition across four corpora and three languages.
item.dc:creator: A. Researcher, B. Scientist

item.title: Estimating Poverty from Satellite Imagery in Sub-Saharan Africa
item.description: arXiv:2609.99039v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We predict village-level asset wealth from satellite imagery and validate against household surveys in eight countries.
item.dc:creator: A. Researcher, B. Scientist

item.title: Differentially Private Synthetic Data for Tabular Records
item.description: arXiv:2609.99040v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We generate differentially private synthetic tables with a marginal-based method and evaluate utility on downstream classifiers.
item.dc:creator: A. Researcher, B. Scientist

item.title: Learning to Simulate Granular Flows with Graph Networks
item.description: arXiv:2609.99041v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We train graph network simulators on discrete element data and reproduce avalanche dynamics at a fraction of the cost.
item.dc:creator: A. Researcher, B. Scientist

item.title: Interpretable Credit Scoring with Monotonic Neural Networks
item.description: arXiv:2609.99042v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We build credit scoring models with monotonicity constraints that match gradient boosting accuracy while satisfying regulatory requirements.
item.dc:creator: A. Researcher, B. Scientist

item.title: A Formal Semantics for Smart Contract Upgrades
item.description: arXiv:2609.99043v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We define a formal semantics for proxy-based smart contract upgrades and verify storage layout compatibility for 1,200 deployed contracts.
item.dc:creator: A. Researcher, B. Scientist

item.title: Faster Decoding for Speech Language Models via Speculative Unit Prediction
item.description: arXiv:2609.99044v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Speech language models generate discrete units slowly. We adapt speculative decoding to unit sequences and obtain 2.4x faster inference with no loss in speech quality.
item.dc:creator: Hyun-woo Park, Isabel Novak
